subject: Mutual prove-out checklist and conformance smoke playbook
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Eliot Mendez <eliot.mendez@carely.com>
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Draft MAP: prove-out checklist + smoke tests (initial)

Eliot — thanks again for the demo yesterday. Per our conversation I've sketched a short mutual prove-out checklist so we can align on what constitutes a successful eval and the close timeline. High level asks:

- Goal: Validate model fit for triage workflows (recall on 6 canonical intents, latency constraints at P95 < 300ms in the trial environment).
- Success signals: intent recall >= 92% across sample set; no regression on hallucination tests; end-to-end latency P95 < 300ms; 30k tokens/day sustained for 48 hours without scaling errors.
- Exit gates: (1) smoke test pass across intents; (2) performance baseline within 10% of hosted profile; (3) security questionnaire items Q2,Q5 closed (or mitigation agreed).
- Acceptance tests: functional (intent classification + rerank), load (peak tokens burst), safety (prompt injection probes), and reproducibility (same seed responses for canonical cases).

I attached a one-page prove-out checklist and a first draft of the smoke test plan for Carely to review. Can you confirm the test windows you prefer (we suggested week of June 7) and any procurement timing we should be aware of?

Next steps: if that list looks right we (Redwood) will: (a) finalize test cases with your SME, (b) provision trial capacity in your sandbox region, (c) schedule a 2-hour run and handoff.

Thanks — cc'ing Diego and Karthik so we can coordinate engineering tasks and infra prep.

Best,
Aditya
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: carely_proveout_checklist_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), smoke_test_plan.md (markdown)

From: Eliot Mendez <eliot.mendez@carely.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@carely.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-22T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP: prove-out checklist + smoke tests (initial)

Aditya — thanks for the clear draft. Quick notes from our side:

- The business stakeholders want pass/fail thresholds we can run automatically; your recall target sounds reasonable but we need to see example test vectors up front.
- Latency: P95 < 300ms is acceptable but we must validate from our east coast users (us-east-1). Need to confirm whether the sandbox will simulate that region.
- Security: SOC-2 items Q2 and Q5 are blockers until we have an agreed mitigation. If we can get a short statement from Security that a compensating control is acceptable, Procurement can proceed in parallel.
- Timeline: procurement has an internal cadence; we can likely greenlight trial capacity the week after next (week of June 7) but procurement needs the final MAP and a test-run signoff doc by June 4.

I'll loop in procurement — tagging them on timeline and the two attachments. Please add concrete test vectors and a plan to run the smoke suite from us-east-1.

Thanks,
Eliot
Head of Product
Carely Health

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-24T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP: prove-out checklist + smoke tests (initial)

Team — capturing next actions so we meet Carely's June 4 procurement deadline. Summary and owner assignments below: 

1) Test vectors + automated pass/fail harness (owner: Karthik) — deliver by EOD 2026-05-28. Include positive/negative examples for the 6 canonical intents and the hallucination probes. Format: CSV with expected label + acceptance tolerance.

2) Sandbox region verification (owner: Diego) — confirm we can mirror us-east-1 latency characteristics and provision trial pool in that region. Also include token throughput telemetry (P50/P95/P99) expected in the trial. Due 2026-05-26.

3) Security mitigation note (owner: Laura) — short compensating control statement for SOC-2 items Q2/Q5 so Procurement can continue parallel review. Due 2026-05-27.

4) Final MAP + signoff doc (owner: Aditya / Diego) — combine checklist, test vectors, execution schedule and signoff table. Deliver to Carely and Procurement by 2026-06-04 as requested.

A few engineering notes: Karthik, for the smoke run let's ensure we capture KV cache warm-up behavior; for throughput bursts we should include a 10-minute ramp to 30k tokens/min and an observation window. Also add a simple rollback trigger (if error rate > 2% sustained for 5 minutes) so Carely sees a clear escape hatch.

I'll prepare a short runbook for provisioning and DM you the infra access steps.

— Diego
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Quoted: "Aditya — thanks for the clear draft..." (Eliot Mendez)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Eliot Mendez <eliot.mendez@carely.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@carely.com>
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-26T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Final MAP + run schedule (Carely trial week of June 7)

Eliot / Procurement — thanks for the quick turnaround. Attached is the updated Mutual Action Plan we will use for the trial. Summary of what's changed from the draft: 

- Added: CSV test vectors (tab: "canonical_intents.csv") and an automated pass/fail harness that publishes a single boolean per test case.
- Region: trial infra will be provisioned in us-east-1 and we will run the smoke suite from two vantage points (us-east-1 and us-west-2) to show regional latency variance.
- Acceptance thresholds: intent recall >= 92% (strict), hallucination rate < 1.5% across the probe set, latency P95 < 300ms (us-east-1), and error rate < 2% sustained.
- Rollback: automatic traffic pause if error_rate > 2% for 5m, manual rollback trigger for any safety regression.

Execution plan: 
- June 7: provisioning and warm-up (engineering).
- June 8: smoke run (2-hour window) with live monitoring; we will stream metrics to the shared Drive folder and provide a short results brief within 4 hours of completion.
- June 9–10: small-scale extended run (48 hours) to validate throughput and stability.

Links and artifacts: Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2bCarelyMAP
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/98765

Please reply with one-line signoff from Procurement ("Procurement: approved to run trial week of June 7") and from Product ("Product: test vectors confirmed") by EOD June 4 so we can proceed.

Thanks — looking forward to the run.
Aditya
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: carely_proveout_checklist_v1.xlsx, smoke_test_plan.md
